facts.fact: Yes: under One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC), beneficiaries can collect their NFSA foodgrain entitlement from any fair price shop in the country using their existing ration card
facts.quote: The ONORC scheme allows beneficiaries to collect their food grain entitlements from any FPS across the country using their existing ration card under the NFSA.

facts.fact: ONORC works in all 36 States/UTs; grain is lifted with the existing ration card or Aadhaar, with biometric authentication on the shop's e-PoS device
facts.quote: The ONORC scheme, successfully implemented across all 36 States/UTs, empowers approximately 81 crore beneficiaries to lift their entitled food grains from any FPS in the country using their existing ration card/Aadhaar card with biometric authentication on an e-PoS device.

facts.fact: The Mera Ration app (NIC) shows ration card details and monthly entitlements and locates the nearest fair price shop
facts.quote: Food Entitlement Information: Check monthly food grain entitlements. - Transaction History: View past food grain transactions. - Locate Nearest FPS: Find nearby Fair Price Shops (FPS).

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish/Hindi; says yes, explains One Nation One Ration Card portability (any FPS in the country with the existing card/Aadhaar biometric) and mentions the Mera Ration app, with citations (nfsa.gov.in / PIB); no personal eligibility verdict.
fail_if: It says the card must be transferred or a new card made in the other State to get ration; says portability is not available; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added: ONORC lets NFSA beneficiaries draw grain at any FPS with the existing card (all 36 States/UTs, Aadhaar biometric on e-PoS); Mera Ration app shows entitlements and nearest FPS.
